correctness.rationale: Every finite unital Boolean homomorphism is inverse image under unique f. D1 preservation equals surjection of each source block onto an entire target block. When a source block has at least k elements, preservation of Dk excludes a smaller target by testing its whole class, and excludes noninjective surjections with a (k−1)-point target set including a duplicated fiber. Conversely the stated surjection and bijection alternatives preserve D1 and Dk. Independent classwise choices, Stirling surjection counts, inclusion-exclusion, and fixed-image characterization of idempotents prove all formulas. Exhaustive checks of 828282 finite function/grade pairs against direct all-subset operator semantics, image ranks, and strictness corroborate without pretending to prove unrestricted cases.

value.rationale: The exact all-parameter classification answers the natural structural question of how one isolated counting operation changes the endomorphism and retraction structure of a finite epistemic equivalence frame. Unlike the ungraded result or a term-function count, it gives a genuinely size-dependent filtration, precise strictness events, explicit full endomorphism image-rank multiplicities, and the minimum-size/large-size staircase for every idempotent support. Natural size classes and counting thresholds motivate the invariant; no arbitrary slice or minor numeric improvement is needed. General finite-frame coverage and predictive exact formulas supply mathematical utility without asserting broader applications.
